content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text rules on a clash over Matthew 1:20 by citing the challenger's covenant-presence reading and the defender's physical-source reading, so it addresses a pressed-verse collision that K-C requires to be weighed chain against chain by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse\": one reading requires comparing the whole chains' footings, while the other permits leaving the clash underdetermined by noting each side's reading of the single verse.","why":"The judge declares Matthew 1:20 underdetermined by pitting the challenger's single-verse covenant-origin reading against the defender's single-verse physical-source reading rather than weighing the two chains' footings as K-C requires."}
